tips.text: Use Three Talon Strike every time it is ready; the third attack knocks the enemy up and each hit shortens your other cooldowns.
Hit with the thrust of Wind Becomes Lightning to slow the enemy and mark them as Challenged. That gives Audacious Charge more range on them.
Open a trade with Audacious Charge, then use Three Talon Strike right away. The charge also gives you extra Attack Speed for your attacks.
Keep attacking your target so they stay Challenged. Crescent Guard then does not knock them back, so use it where it pushes the other enemies away.
Trade in short bursts so every third attack triggers Determination. The bonus damage also heals you.
Once you use Crescent Guard, enemies far from you cannot hurt you for a few seconds. Stay on your target and hit them while the protection lasts.
Finish all three attacks of Three Talon Strike on a target; the third knocks them up and each hit shortens your other cooldowns.
Open a fight with Audacious Charge on a target who is out of reach; it works from farther away on an enemy already Challenged.
Aim Wind Becomes Lightning so the thrust at the end hits your target; it slows them and marks them as Challenged.
Hold Crescent Guard until the enemy is not Challenged; the ones you have marked are not knocked back.
Use Crescent Guard to knock back enemies who are not Challenged, then fight from inside its circle; enemies standing far outside it cannot hurt you.
Keep attacking in a fight; every third hit from Determination deals extra damage and heals you.

combos.name: Challenge gap close
combos.when: Chasing or engaging an enemy champion just outside your normal charge range.
combos.text: Hit the thrust of the first spell to mark the target as Challenged, which lengthens the charge's range. Charge in, then use the empowered attacks to knock up.

combos.name: Cast during the dash
combos.when: Engaging a target with the charge.
combos.text: You can cast the empowered-attack spell while the charge is still in flight. Activate it mid-dash so the first strike lands as soon as you arrive.

combos.name: Keep the target in with ultimate
combos.when: Fighting a carry you want to keep close while peeling others off.
combos.text: Your last attacked champion is Challenged and is not knocked back by the ultimate. Hit your target first, so everyone else flies away and the target stays.

tips.text: Hit the enemy three times with Three Talon Strike. The third hit knocks them up, and each hit shortens your other cooldowns.
Land the thrust of Wind Becomes Lightning on the enemy. It slows them and reveals them, which helps you chase.
Mark an enemy with Wind Becomes Lightning first. Audacious Charge then reaches them from farther away.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap, then start Three Talon Strike right away. The bonus Attack Speed makes your hits count.
At level 6, wait until you are in the middle of the enemy team before using Crescent Guard. It knocks back every enemy who is not Challenged.
Keep hitting your Challenged target while Crescent Guard is active. Enemies standing outside the sweep range cannot hurt you.
Mix basic attacks into your trades. Every third hit with Determination deals extra damage and heals you.

combos.name: Thrust mark into charge
combos.when: When an enemy is just outside your charge range and you want to close the gap.
combos.text: The thrust marks the farthest champion hit as Challenged, which lengthens your charge range. Charge in, then start your talon strikes.

tips.text: Dodge the edge of The Darkin Blade, since the tip hits hardest and knocks you up. Step sideways, or charge in with Audacious Charge once he has spent the swing.
Hit Aatrox with Wind Becomes Lightning to mark him as Challenged. Audacious Charge then reaches further, so you can close the gap on him.
Walk out of Infernal Chains sideways or toward Aatrox before it ends so you are not pulled back and hit twice.
Use all three strikes of Three Talon Strike in a trade. The third knocks him up, and each strike shortens your other cooldowns.
Save Crescent Guard for when he commits to a fight. He can't escape the sweep unless he is Challenged, and you take no damage from enemies outside it.
Save Crescent Guard for when Briar is mid-Blood Frenzy on top of you. Her Certain Death fear and her stun are no help once the sweep lands.
Finish all three Three Talon Strike hits when Briar leaps in. The last hit knocks her up and your other cooldowns drop with each hit.
Use Wind Becomes Lightning to slow Briar as she closes in. Then use Audacious Charge to stay on her when she tries to run.
Fight Briar when she has used Head Rush. Her stun is her main way into a trade, and she is easier to punish without it.
Stay out of Apprehend range when it is ready, and fight him right after he has missed it. Without it he has a hard time pulling you into a trade.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap, then finish the third Three Talon Strike attack. It knocks him up and cuts your other cooldowns.
Hit him with the thrust of Wind Becomes Lightning to slow him, so he has a harder time reaching you with Crippling Strike.
Don't let a long brawl build up his Hemorrhage stacks. Trade briefly and leave, because Noxian Guillotine hurts most at full stacks.
Don't use Audacious Charge on Fiora while her Riposte is ready. She can dodge the stun and turn it back on you, so bait Riposte first.
Hold the knock up from Three Talon Strike until Riposte is spent. Fiora's parry of a knock up lets her stun you instead.
Look for the gap after Riposte ends and then commit with Wind Becomes Lightning. Its slow makes it hard for her to leave.
Fight with the Challenged mark on her. Audacious Charge reaches farther against a Challenged enemy, so it is easy to catch her when she backs off.
Save Crescent Guard for when she commits to a Vital. You stay safe from enemies outside the sweep, and her stab can't reach you from range.
Charge in with Audacious Charge when Gangplank walks up to a keg; the slow cuts his chance to run, and you can fight him close.
Hit Gangplank with Wind Becomes Lightning to mark him as Challenged; Audacious Charge then reaches farther to him.
Finish all three hits of Three Talon Strike so Gangplank is knocked up. Each hit also shortens your other cooldowns.
Trade when Gangplank has no kegs stocked. Without them his damage and slows are much weaker.
Gangplank can wipe your slows and stuns with Remove Scurvy, so wait for it to be used before you go for a kill.
Gangplank's Cannon Barrage can hit you from anywhere after level 6, so don't stay low on health near him.
Walk up with Audacious Charge to start a trade, then finish the Three Talon Strike combo so the third hit knocks Garen up.
Hit Garen with Wind Becomes Lightning to get him slowed and marked as Challenged, which gives Audacious Charge more range on him.
Garen's Decisive Strike removes slows and silences you. Expect it when he is about to trade, and do not rely on slowing him to chase.
Do not stand next to Garen while Judgment is spinning. Step out of range, then come back in with Audacious Charge when it ends.
Back off when your health is low, because Demacian Justice hurts more the less health you have.
Crescent Guard makes you immune to damage from enemies outside its range, so use it to survive when Garen's team piles in.
Hit Jayce with Wind Becomes Lightning when he stands at range; the thrust slows him and marks him as Challenged.
Charge in with Audacious Charge once Jayce is marked as Challenged; it reaches farther, so he can't kite you easily.
Fight when Jayce is in Cannon form. Three Talon Strike then knocks him up on the third hit and keeps him in your reach.
Save Crescent Guard for when Jayce and you are trading up close. It hurts him, and you take no damage from enemies outside the sweep.
Land Wind Becomes Lightning on K'Sante before you jump in; the thrust slows him and marks him as Challenged, so Audacious Charge reaches farther.
Hit all three Three Talon Strike attacks to knock him up, and every hit shortens your other cooldowns, so trade with the full combo.
Do not stand in line with K'Sante's Ntofo Strikes after his first hit lands. The second cast pulls and stuns you.
Do not fight in the charge of Path Maker. He cannot be interrupted while charging, so step out of its line and punish him afterwards.
Use Crescent Guard when he goes All Out. He is much squishier then, and your invulnerability while he is far away helps you finish the fight.
Walk up and use Audacious Charge on Malphite to close the gap fast, then finish the Three Talon Strike combo before he can slow you.
Hit Malphite with Wind Becomes Lightning to mark him as Challenged. Audacious Charge then reaches him from farther away.
Fight when Granite Shield is down. Malphite's Thunderclap armor is much lower without it, so your trades hit harder.
Stay out of Malphite's Unstoppable Force at level 6. Keep your distance in fights, because his dash cannot be stopped and it knocks you up.
Crescent Guard knocks Malphite back unless he is Challenged. Hit him with an attack or Audacious Charge first so he stays close.
Trade right after Malphite uses Seismic Shard, while his mana is low and he is slowing you less.
Hit Wind Becomes Lightning on Mordekaiser to mark him as Challenged; it also slows him, so Audacious Charge then reaches him from farther away.
Trade in short bursts and step away when his Darkness Rise aura turns on; staying inside it costs you a lot of health.
Do not fight Mordekaiser when his Indestructible shield is ready. Make him spend it first, or wait for it to fade.
Stay out of a straight line with him and keep minions around you. Death's Grasp pulls you in, so keep your distance.
Stand beside a minion rather than alone; Obliterate hits harder when only one enemy is in it.
Land all three Three Talon Strike attacks to knock him up and shorten your other cooldowns, then follow with your other abilities.
Hit Wind Becomes Lightning on Rumble to mark him as Challenged, then charge with Audacious Charge; the mark lets your charge reach farther.
Finish all three Three Talon Strike attacks so the last one knocks Rumble up; it also shortens your other cooldowns.
Go in when Rumble overheats, because he cannot cast spells then. Do not stay in the burning trail of The Equalizer.
Use Crescent Guard at level 6 when Rumble is not the Challenged target, since only non-Challenged enemies are knocked back and stunned.
Fight inside his Flamespitter range only briefly; get on him with Audacious Charge and stay close so he cannot poke you from a distance.
Sidestep Decimating Smash when you see Sion start to charge; if it lands after a long charge you are knocked up and stunned.
Charge in with Audacious Charge the moment Sion starts charging; he can't walk while charging, so you get a free hit.
Land the third Three Talon Strike attack to knock Sion up, then follow with Wind Becomes Lightning so he stays slowed.
Back off when Sion shields with Soul Furnace; trade after it breaks or wait for it to explode harmlessly.
Don't fight Sion to the death near his tower; when he dies he comes back swinging, so walk away from his Glory in Death.
Charge in with Audacious Charge once Teemo steps up to trade, then finish the three Three Talon Strike attacks. The third one knocks him up.
Teemo's Blinding Dart makes your basic attacks miss. Fight when it is on cooldown, and spend your trades on your abilities.
Use Wind Becomes Lightning to close the gap on a retreating Teemo. It slows him and marks him as Challenged, so Audacious Charge reaches farther.
Teemo hides in brush and goes invisible. Walk around bushes, or hit them with Wind Becomes Lightning, which reveals champions it hits.
Avoid walking into brush or a river you can't see into. Noxious Trap mushrooms are hidden and slow you.
At level 6, Crescent Guard knocks Teemo back and stuns him if he isn't Challenged. Use it when you are all-in on him.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap on Vayne; she is fragile, so land on her and finish the third Three Talon Strike hit to knock her up.
Stay away from walls behind you when Vayne has Condemn ready, or you will be stunned and take big damage.
Hit Vayne with Wind Becomes Lightning to leave her slowed, so she cannot kite you easily with Tumble.
Trade with Vayne in short bursts and do not stay in range for long attack chains, since her third hit with Silver Bolts hurts.
Save Crescent Guard for when Vayne is on top of you; it knocks her back and protects you from damage from enemies outside it.
Hit Yone with Wind Becomes Lightning to mark him as Challenged, then use Audacious Charge, which reaches farther against a Challenged target.
Finish all three Three Talon Strike attacks to knock Yone up, and fight him while he is stuck there.
Yone's Mortal Steel is how he gets in close. Step out of its line, then trade back while it is on cooldown.
Wind Becomes Lightning slows Yone when the thrust hits, so use it to stop him from running away or diving in.
If Yone is in his spirit form and about to snap back, back away from him. Fighting him then lets him repeat his damage.
Save Crescent Guard for when Yone commits to a fight. It knocks back enemies who are not Challenged, and he stays Challenged only if your last hit was on him.
Charge in with Audacious Charge when Aatrox uses The Darkin Blade, so you close the gap and slow him.
Land the third Three Talon Strike hit to knock him up, then follow with Wind Becomes Lightning while he is stuck.
Use Crescent Guard when Aatrox is not the last champion you hit, because it knocks back only enemies who are not Challenged.
Step out of Infernal Chains toward the sides or toward Aatrox, so you are not pulled back.
Charge in with Audacious Charge, then finish Three Talon Strike so the third hit knocks Ambessa up and you keep control.
Hit Ambessa with Wind Becomes Lightning to leave her slowed, then use the extra Audacious Charge range on her to close the gap.
Hold Crescent Guard until Ambessa commits. While you attack her she stays Challenged, so the sweep will not knock her back.
Do not stand still when Ambessa braces with Repudiation. Hit her before it or wait it out, because her shield absorbs your damage and boosts her slam.
Hit Amumu with Wind Becomes Lightning early; it slows him and marks him as Challenged, so Audacious Charge reaches him from farther away.
Keep Crescent Guard until Amumu has used Curse of the Sad Mummy; the stunned team is easy to clean up after it.
Fight Amumu with your attacks and Three Talon Strike rather than relying on magic damage; his Tantrum cuts physical hits.
Do not stand in Despair for long; it burns more on high-health targets and keeps his Curse going.
Charge in with Audacious Charge, then finish the third Three Talon Strike attack to knock her up and keep her from dashing away.
Hit Bel'Veth with the thrust of Wind Becomes Lightning to slow her; that makes her dashes easier to catch and fight around.
Hold Crescent Guard until she dives in. While you are Challenged-marked on her, the knockback skips her, so use it when others are in range.
Fight her early, before she stacks Lavender from takedowns and her attack speed grows out of control.
Fight her when her dash directions are used up; she then has fewer ways to escape.
Dash onto Brand with Audacious Charge to close the gap fast; he is a mage with little to stop you once you are on him.
Finish all three hits of Three Talon Strike so Brand is knocked up and you get your cooldowns back.
Aim Wind Becomes Lightning down the line at Brand; the thrust slows him and marks him as Challenged, which makes Audacious Charge reach farther.
Keep Crescent Guard for when Brand is on top of you. Its damage hurts, and it makes you safe from his friends outside the sweep.
Do not stand in a group with your team when Brand's Pyroclasm is coming; spread out so it cannot bounce between you.
Cast Wind Becomes Lightning on Briar as she leaps in; the thrust leaves her slowed and marked as Challenged, which gives your Audacious Charge extra reach.
Finish all three hits of Three Talon Strike on Briar; the last one knocks her up, which stops her from chasing you for a moment.
Use Crescent Guard when Briar locks onto you; it knocks her back and stuns her unless she is Challenged, so skip hitting her first.
Don't trade long with Briar when she is low on health; her bleed heals her more the more she is missing, so burst her down or leave.
Use Wind Becomes Lightning to mark Darius as Challenged, then close the gap with Audacious Charge; it reaches farther against a marked target.
Finish Three Talon Strike on Darius for the knock up, which gives you a window to hit him without his axe swings.
Fight him with Crescent Guard ready. While it is active, enemies outside the sweep can't damage you, so Darius has to stay close.
Stay out of Apprehend range when you can. Its pull cancels your approach and leaves you slowed beside him.
Don't trade in a long fight; Darius gets stronger as his Hemorrhage stacks build. Burst him with your abilities, then back off.
Hit Diana with Wind Becomes Lightning to mark her as Challenged; Audacious Charge then reaches her from farther away.
Finish all three Three Talon Strike attacks on Diana so she is knocked up and cannot dash away for a moment.
Save Crescent Guard for when Diana is on top of you. Her Moonfall is a pull, so use yours when she dives in and her team clumps up.
Wait out Pale Cascade before you commit; her shield and orbs make early trades poor for you.
Save Three Talon Strike's third attack for when Dr. Mundo is walking at you; the knock up stops his approach and keeps you in range.
Dr. Mundo resists the first immobilizing effect, so use Three Talon Strike's knock up on something minor first, or expect it to be wasted.
Crescent Guard's knockback stuns, but Dr. Mundo resists it while his passive is ready, so wait until it has been used before you ult him.
Step over to destroy the canister he drops, or stand near it so he can't grab it safely. That denies his healing.
Sidestep Infected Bonesaw; it stops at the first enemy, so a minion in front of you can soak it.
Hit him with Wind Becomes Lightning to slow him and mark him, then Audacious Charge reaches farther to close in.
Burst him before Maximum Dosage; once it is active he heals through your damage, so back off or go after someone else.
Hit Wind Becomes Lightning on Ekko first; the thrust slows him and marks him Challenged, so Audacious Charge then reaches him from farther away.
Finish all three Three Talon Strike attacks; the third knocks Ekko up and stops him from dashing away.
Hold Crescent Guard until Ekko is not Challenged. Hitting him with attacks or Audacious Charge first marks him, and marked enemies are not knocked back.
Ekko's Parallel Convergence stuns after a delay. Walk out of the circle rather than standing in it when he places it.
Burst Ekko before he can use Chronobreak, then fight him again once it is on cooldown.
Use Wind Becomes Lightning on Evelynn as she appears; it reveals her and leaves her slowed, so she can't slip away.
Chase with Audacious Charge once she is Challenged; its range grows on Challenged targets, so she can't simply walk away.
Finish Three Talon Strike on Evelynn to knock her up and cut your other cooldowns, then follow with your other abilities.
Hold Crescent Guard until Evelynn jumps on you or a teammate. Its sweep hurts her and its damage immunity makes her follow-up fall flat.
Stay near allies when you see Allure's arrow point at you. Evelynn wants you alone for her charm.
Dash onto Fiddlesticks with Audacious Charge as soon as they channel Bountiful Harvest or Crowstorm, then keep hitting them to cut it short.
Finish all three hits of Three Talon Strike on Fiddlesticks; the last one knocks them up and interrupts a channel.
Hold Crescent Guard for when Crowstorm lands on your team; its knockback stuns Fiddlesticks if they are not Challenged.
Be careful in brush and dark areas; Fiddlesticks can fear you from hiding with Reap, so keep vision around you.
Hit Fiddlesticks with Wind Becomes Lightning to reveal them and Challenge them, so Audacious Charge reaches farther.
Use Audacious Charge to close on Graves, then land all three Three Talon Strike hits so the last one knocks him up.
Save Crescent Guard for when Graves is next to you; it knocks him back and then protects you from his allies' damage from outside its range.
Hit Graves with Wind Becomes Lightning to slow him and mark him Challenged. Audacious Charge then reaches farther.
Fight Graves in close range, since his Smoke Screen slows you and hides what is outside it. Step out of the cloud to stop its effects.
Hit Gwen with Wind Becomes Lightning to slow her and mark her as Challenged. Then Audacious Charge reaches her from farther away.
Gwen can't be targeted from outside her Hallowed Mist, so Audacious Charge won't work on her there. Step inside the mist, or wait until it ends.
Gwen's mist follows her only once. Wait for her to leave it, then jump on her.
Finish all three hits of Three Talon Strike so the last one knocks her up. Gwen is weak when she can't set up her attacks, so fight her early.
Use Crescent Guard when Gwen is close, but not on a Challenged Gwen, because she won't be knocked back. Then enemies outside the sweep can't hurt you.
Hit Hecarim with Three Talon Strike three times and finish with the knock up. It also shortens your other cooldowns, so start fights with it.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap when Hecarim tries to run away. It slows him briefly, and its range is longer on a Challenged target.
Aim Wind Becomes Lightning down a line so the thrust hits him. It slows him and marks him as Challenged.
Hit Hecarim with an attack or Audacious Charge before Crescent Guard so he is Challenged. A Challenged enemy is not knocked back.
Fight Hecarim before he builds speed. His Devastating Charge hits hardest after a long run, so stay near him and don't give him that run-up.
Use Audacious Charge to close on Ivern when he is slippery; it reaches farther if he is Challenged, so hit him with Wind Becomes Lightning first.
Stay out of a straight line with Ivern when you can. Rootcaller stops at the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion or another enemy in front of you.
Use Crescent Guard when Ivern and Daisy are both close. It knocks back and stuns anyone not Challenged.
Finish all three Three Talon Strike attacks on Ivern. The last one knocks him up, and each hit shortens your other cooldowns.
Jump him when he is alone in the jungle, before Daisy is out to help him.
Keep your distance from the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard; when Dragon Strike hits it, you get knocked up.
Open with Audacious Charge, then land all three Three Talon Strike hits. The third hit knocks him up and your cooldowns come back faster.
Hit Jarvan with Wind Becomes Lightning to mark him as Challenged. Audacious Charge then reaches farther, and Crescent Guard will not knock him back.
If Jarvan's Cataclysm traps you, use Crescent Guard. It makes you immune to damage from enemies outside the sweep range, so his team cannot help him.
Don't trade attacks while Jax's Counter Strike is up; he dodges them and stuns you when it ends. Wait it out, then start your Three Talon Strike.
Audacious Charge cannot be dodged, so use it to close the gap even when Jax is dodging attacks.
Hit Jax with Wind Becomes Lightning to slow him and mark him as Challenged. Your Audacious Charge then reaches farther, so he can't easily get away.
Fight in short bursts and finish your Three Talon Strike combo. Jax gets much stronger the longer he keeps attacking.
Keep Crescent Guard for when Jax jumps in. It knocks him back and stuns him unless he is Challenged, so use it on a Jax you haven't been hitting.
Dash onto Jayce with Audacious Charge when he swaps stance; it reaches farther on a Challenged target and slows him, so he can't easily escape.
Finish all three attacks of Three Talon Strike so Jayce is knocked up, then keep hitting him before he can leap or blast away.
Aim Wind Becomes Lightning at Jayce when he stands at range; the thrust slows him and marks him as Challenged.
Use Crescent Guard when Jayce is close and not Challenged, so he is knocked back. It also protects you from his attacks at range.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap on Karthus, then finish your Three Talon Strike attacks so he is knocked up.
Hit Karthus with Wind Becomes Lightning to leave him slowed, so he struggles to get away.
Karthus is fragile, so dive him early before he has farmed. Walk through his Wall of Pain only if you must, since it slows you.
Finish Karthus quickly. After he dies he can still cast for a few seconds, so step away from his corpse.
Keep your health high once Karthus has Requiem, because it hits you from anywhere on the map. Crescent Guard will not stop it.
Use Audacious Charge to close on Kayn when he tries to run, then finish the third Three Talon Strike to knock him up.
Hit Kayn with Wind Becomes Lightning when he steps in; it leaves him slowed and marks him as Challenged, which gives Audacious Charge more range.
Save Crescent Guard for when Kayn dives onto you. Its sweep deals big damage, and for a few seconds enemies far from you can't hurt you.
Charge Kayn while he is inside a wall if he comes out near you. Audacious Charge targets him as soon as he can be seen.
Stay near your minions or allies when Kha'Zix is around; Taste Their Fear hits far harder on a target that is isolated.
Use Audacious Charge to close on Kha'Zix when he tries to back off. Charging a Challenged target reaches even farther.
Land Wind Becomes Lightning on Kha'Zix to reveal him and leave him slowed, so he cannot sneak away or pick a fight on his terms.
Finish all three Three Talon Strike attacks on Kha'Zix; the last one knocks him up and the strikes shorten your other cooldowns.
Save Crescent Guard for when Kha'Zix dives you. It knocks back anyone who is not Challenged and shields you from enemies outside the sweep.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap on Kindred; she is fragile, so land your Three Talon Strike attacks fast and finish the knock up before she vaults away.
Hit Kindred with Wind Becomes Lightning so she is slowed and revealed, then charge in. Her Dance of Arrows is her main escape.
Do not chase Kindred inside Lamb's Respite; nobody inside can die. Back off or wait until it ends before you commit.
Save Crescent Guard for when Kindred is on top of you. It knocks her back unless she is Challenged, and you take no damage from enemies outside the sweep.
Invade her camps early when Wolf's Frenzy is on cooldown. Wolf only fights inside his zone, so step out of it or fight her before she places it.
Use Audacious Charge on Lee Sin to close the gap, then land all three Three Talon Strike hits. The third hit knocks him up.
Hold Crescent Guard until Lee Sin commits. Its sweep knocks back anyone who isn't Challenged, so attack him first to keep him Challenged.
Use Wind Becomes Lightning when Lee Sin walks into range. It slows him and reveals him, which makes his escapes harder.
Fight Lee Sin when he is low on Energy. He needs it to chain his abilities, and Xin Zhao's attack-based damage doesn't use it.
Use Audacious Charge to close on Lillia when she tries to kite; it also slows her briefly so you can land Three Talon Strike.
Finish all three Three Talon Strike attacks; the last one knocks Lillia up and cuts your other cooldowns.
Hit Lillia with Wind Becomes Lightning when she runs; it slows her and marks her as Challenged, which extends your Audacious Charge range.
Save Crescent Guard for when Lillia jumps in with her combo; the sweep deals big damage and while it lasts, enemies far away cannot hurt you.
Sidestep out of the middle of Lillia's big ground slam, since the center hurts the most.
Land the third Three Talon Strike on Master Yi to knock him up; it also cuts your other cooldowns with each hit.
Hit Master Yi with Wind Becomes Lightning to leave him slowed and revealed, then use Audacious Charge to reach him from farther away.
Save Crescent Guard for when Master Yi dives in; it knocks back enemies who aren't Challenged and shields you from distant enemies.
Master Yi's Highlander makes him immune to slows, so do not rely on Wind Becomes Lightning to hold him once it is active. Use the knock up instead.
Land all three Three Talon Strike attacks; the third knocks Wukong up, and each hit shortens your other cooldowns.
Hit Wukong with Wind Becomes Lightning to slow him and mark him as Challenged, which gives Audacious Charge more range onto him.
When Wukong vanishes with Warrior Trickster, hit the real one. Charge or attack the target that Wukong damaged last, not the standing clone.
Save Crescent Guard for after Wukong spends Cyclone, so the knockback and damage land when he can't spin away.
Don't trade for long when Wukong has stacked Stone Skin; he gets much tougher the longer he fights.
Charge in with Audacious Charge when Naafiri's packmates are away, then finish with Three Talon Strike so the third hit knocks her up.
Use Wind Becomes Lightning on her to slow her and reveal her, then chase; this works even when she tries to slip away.
Hold Crescent Guard until she commits to a fight. She cannot be hurt by champions outside your sweep range while you are protected.
She becomes untargetable with The Call of the Pack and Eviscerate, so do not waste Audacious Charge while she is untargetable.
Charge in with Audacious Charge when Nidalee is out of position; it slows her and closes the gap fast.
Land Three Talon Strike's third hit to knock her up, then keep attacking before she can get away.
Use Wind Becomes Lightning on her when she runs; it leaves her slowed and marks her, so Audacious Charge reaches farther.
Save Crescent Guard for when she pounces on you; the sweep knocks back anyone not marked, and you take no damage from enemies far away.
Charge in with Audacious Charge before Nocturne's Unspeakable Horror tether finishes; the dash can pull you out of range and break it.
Land all three Three Talon Strike attacks to knock Nocturne up and cut your other cooldowns, so don't waste the combo on minions in a duel.
Bait Shroud of Darkness with Wind Becomes Lightning first, then follow with Audacious Charge once the shield is gone.
Stay near your team when Nocturne casts Paranoia, and use Crescent Guard to knock him back if he dashes onto you.
Dash onto Nunu with Audacious Charge once Absolute Zero is spent or he is chasing a teammate; his big slow makes it easy to catch him.
Step sideways or turn sharply when Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls at you; the snowball turns slowly and knocks you up if it connects.
Finish all three Three Talon Strike attacks on Nunu; the third knocks him up and the strikes shorten your other cooldowns.
Keep Crescent Guard for after Nunu starts Absolute Zero; its invulnerability to enemies outside the sweep lets you fight through the blizzard.
Hit Nunu with Wind Becomes Lightning when he comes to you; it slows him and marks him as Challenged.
Land the third Three Talon Strike on Pantheon to knock him up, then follow with Audacious Charge or your attacks while he is helpless.
Fight Pantheon from behind when he braces with Aegis Assault; he ignores damage from the front. Hit him from the side or wait it out.
Hit Pantheon with Wind Becomes Lightning to mark him as Challenged. Then Audacious Charge reaches farther and Crescent Guard will not knock him back.
Keep your health up against Pantheon. A held Comet Spear hits much harder on low health targets.
Use Crescent Guard when Pantheon jumps on you in a fight. Enemies outside the sweep can't hurt you, which cuts off his team's help.
Charge in with Audacious Charge when Qiyana is away from her dash; it slows her, and you can follow with Three Talon Strike.
Finish all three Three Talon Strike hits to knock Qiyana up; it stops her from dashing away mid-trade.
Hold Crescent Guard until Qiyana commits to a fight, then use it to knock her back, stun her and take no damage from enemies outside the sweep.
Hit Qiyana with Wind Becomes Lightning to slow and reveal her, which stops her from slipping away in the brush.
Stay spread from Qiyana's ultimate near walls. Fight away from terrain so her stun cannot trigger.
Don't rely on Three Talon Strike's knock up to finish a fight when Rammus has Defensive Ball Curl up; he takes less damage and hits you back for every attack.
Hit Rammus while Defensive Ball Curl is down. Rammus is much weaker without it, so use your full combo then.
Use Wind Becomes Lightning to slow Rammus and keep him from rolling onto you. It also marks him as Challenged, so Audacious Charge reaches farther.
Hold Crescent Guard if Rammus is Challenged. His Powerball can't escape it, but a non-Challenged enemy is knocked back and stunned.
Stay out of Frenzying Taunt range when you can; a taunt forces you to attack Rammus while his allies hit you.
Save Three Talon Strike's third attack to knock Rek'Sai up when she is burrowed and trying to leave, or to finish a fight on your terms.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap when she tries to run, since it slows her and cannot be dodged.
Aim Wind Becomes Lightning down the line she is fleeing along; the thrust slows her and shows where she is.
Use Crescent Guard once she commits with Void Rush or Furious Bite; it knocks back anyone not Challenged and shields you from outside damage.
Hold Three Talon Strike until Rengar leaps at you; the third attack knocks him up and stops his follow-up.
Use Wind Becomes Lightning when Rengar flees or closes in; it leaves him slowed and marked as Challenged, which lengthens Audacious Charge.
Save Crescent Guard for when Rengar jumps on you. It knocks back anyone not Challenged and shields you from enemies outside the sweep.
Stay out of brush when Rengar may be near; his leap from it gets him on you before you can react.
Hit Sejuani with the third Three Talon Strike attack to knock her up. Her Frost Armor makes her slow-immune, so rely on that knock up, not slows, to hold her.
Stay away from Sejuani's melee allies and from her own attacks when you fight her. Four stacks of Frost let Permafrost stun you.
Crescent Guard won't knock back a Challenged enemy. Hit Sejuani first to keep her near, or hit someone else to throw her away.
Sidestep Arctic Assault. It ends on the first enemy champion it hits, so a miss leaves her out of position for a fight.
Check bushes and choke points before you walk in; Jack In The Box hides itself and fears you. Fight near it and you can be feared into Shaco's burst.
Hit Shaco with Wind Becomes Lightning; it reveals him and slows him, so he is easier to catch and Audacious Charge reaches farther.
Finish all three hits of Three Talon Strike on Shaco; the last one knocks him up and stops him escaping.
Save Crescent Guard for when Shaco's clone and boxes are on you. Enemies outside the sweep can't hurt you, so you can fight on safely.
Kill the clone from range or let it burst away from you, because it explodes when it dies and drops boxes that fear. Don't chase the real Shaco into them.
Finish all three Three Talon Strike attacks on Shyvana; the last one knocks her up, and each hit shortens your other cooldowns.
Hit Shyvana with Wind Becomes Lightning to slow her. It also reveals her and lets Audacious Charge reach farther.
Hold Crescent Guard until her Inferno Aegis shield is up and she has committed. Her target is Challenged, so she is not knocked back, so aim at the others.
Fight her early, before she has Dragon Form. Avoid long brawls once she is a dragon, because her abilities get stronger.
Use Audacious Charge to close on Skarner when he tries to walk away; it also leaves him slowed for a moment.
Stun Skarner's charge by finishing Three Talon Strike on him, since its third hit knocks him up. Do it before he drags an ally into a wall.
Hit Skarner with Wind Becomes Lightning's thrust to slow him and reveal him, which helps you chase or track him in the jungle.
Save Crescent Guard for when Skarner's Impale or charge comes your way; the sweep punishes him if he walks into you.
Use Audacious Charge to close on Sylas when he steps forward, since it slows him and the dash cannot be dodged.
Land your third Three Talon Strike hit to knock Sylas up, then keep hitting him before he can use Kingslayer to heal.
Aim Wind Becomes Lightning at Sylas so the thrust slows him and marks him as Challenged, which makes your charge reach further.
Save Crescent Guard for when Sylas is hurt and close; you take no damage from enemies outside the sweep, so his chains cannot hit you from range.
Fight Sylas right after he spends Abduct; his stun and pull are his best way to start a fight.
Charge Talon with Audacious Charge when he commits, then finish with Three Talon Strike so the third hit knocks him up.
Hold Crescent Guard until Talon jumps on you; you take no damage from enemies outside the sweep for a while, so his team cannot help him.
Use Wind Becomes Lightning on Talon as he runs away; it leaves him slowed and shows where he is.
Look for fights while Shadow Assault is on cooldown; Talon has far less ability to escape or finish a fight then.
Fight Trundle away from his Frozen Domain; inside it he moves and attacks much faster and heals more.
Finish all three Three Talon Strike attacks quickly; the last one knocks Trundle up and each one shortens your other cooldowns.
Hit Trundle with Wind Becomes Lightning to mark him as Challenged, then use Audacious Charge, which reaches farther on a Challenged enemy.
Keep attacking Trundle while he is Challenged. Crescent Guard then deals damage without knocking him back.
Do not fight beside a Pillar of Ice. It slows you and the pillar blocks your path.
Land Wind Becomes Lightning on Udyr early; it slows him and marks him as Challenged, so Audacious Charge reaches him from farther away.
Finish the third Three Talon Strike attack to knock Udyr up, then keep hitting him while he can't act.
Hold Crescent Guard for when Udyr is on you. Being Challenged is the only thing that stops its knockback and stun, so hit him with an attack first.
Respect Udyr once his Blazing Stampede is awakened; it stops stuns and slows. Wait for it to end before you commit your crowd control.
Use Audacious Charge on Vi when she is at the edge of your reach; it gets more range against enemies marked Challenged, and it slows her.
Finish a Three Talon Strike combo to knock Vi up, then fight while she is stuck in place.
Hold Crescent Guard until Vi commits to you. While it lasts, enemies outside the sweep cannot damage you, so her allies cannot help her.
Aim Wind Becomes Lightning to hit Vi with the thrust; she is slowed and revealed, so you can chase her or trade on your terms.
Do not stand in a long brawl once Vi's third hit lands; it lowers your Armor and speeds her attacks. Trade in short bursts and leave.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap on Viego, then land all three Three Talon Strike hits so the third one knocks him up.
Wind Becomes Lightning slows Viego when the thrust hits. Use it to stop him running away or sliding out of a fight.
Save Crescent Guard for when Viego is up close. Its knockback sends away enemies you have not Challenged, and you take no damage from enemies outside the sweep.
Fight Viego early, before his takedowns can snowball. A kill lets him take over the body of the champion he beat.
Knock Volibear up with the third strike of Three Talon Strike to stop his Thundering Smash pounce before it lands.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap when Volibear runs, since it cannot be dodged. It slows him, so you can keep hitting.
Hit Volibear with Wind Becomes Lightning to mark him as Challenged, which lets Audacious Charge reach farther.
Use Crescent Guard against Volibear after he leaps in with Stormbringer. It is worth using when his friends are far away, since you take no damage from them.
Fight before Volibear's passive has built up stacks, because his attacks get faster and then hit nearby enemies with lightning.
Finish the third Three Talon Strike on Warwick to knock him up. That gives you a free window to hit him, so open fights with it.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap, since it cannot be dodged. It also slows Warwick, so he has a harder time running or lunging away.
Hit Warwick with the thrust of Wind Becomes Lightning to slow him and mark him Challenged. That extends the range of Audacious Charge onto him.
Do not fight Warwick when he is low on health, because his attacks heal him much more then. Finish him fast with your combo or back off.
Hit Warwick with an attack or Audacious Charge before using Crescent Guard. Challenged enemies are not knocked back, so you stay in melee range with him.
Stay off the goo Zac drops when he hits you; he heals by walking over it, and you can step on it to destroy it.
Finish all three attacks of Three Talon Strike on Zac; the third knocks him up and the strikes shorten your other cooldowns.
When Zac dies and splits into bloblets, hunt them all down; if any survive he comes back.
Use Crescent Guard when Zac has jumped in on you; it knocks him back unless he is Challenged, and shields you from enemies outside the sweep.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap on Zac when he tries to leave after a trade; it has longer range on a Challenged target.
Zac's Elastic Slingshot can be interrupted by a knock up, so hit him with the third Three Talon Strike attack while he charges.
Hold Crescent Guard until Zed uses Death Mark on you or a teammate; its knockback and damage punish him when he lands beside you.
Use Audacious Charge to stick to Zed when he swaps away; it slows him and your range is longer on a Challenged target.
Land the third Three Talon Strike attack to knock Zed up when he commits, so he can't leave right away.
Aim Wind Becomes Lightning down a line to slow Zed and reveal him, then chase him.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap on Zyra; it also slows her and nearby enemies. Follow with Three Talon Strike so your third attack knocks her up.
Dodge sideways when Zyra casts Grasping Roots, because a rooted Xin Zhao cannot dash in. Fight where she has no seeds so her plants stay small.
Step on her seeds to destroy them before she grows plants, and walk around brush where she may have set a trap.
Hit Zyra with Wind Becomes Lightning to slow her and mark her as Challenged. Your Audacious Charge then reaches farther, so you can close the gap.
Save Crescent Guard for when you are on top of Zyra; it hits hard and blocks damage from enemies outside its range. Her plants inside it can still hit you.
Walk up and use Audacious Charge on Ahri when she is out of position; it closes the gap and slows her.
Land Three Talon Strike's third hit to knock Ahri up, so she can't easily run away.
Stay behind minions so Charm hits them first and not you.
Use Wind Becomes Lightning to slow her and mark her as Challenged; Audacious Charge then reaches farther.
Look for an all-in when Spirit Rush is on cooldown. Ahri has far less escape and survival then.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap when Akali leaves her smoke or backs off; it cannot be dodged and slows her.
Land all three hits of Three Talon Strike on Akali; the last one knocks her up so you can follow with more damage.
Aim Wind Becomes Lightning down the line she will flee along; the thrust slows her and shows her position.
Hold Crescent Guard for when Akali jumps on you with her ultimate; it knocks back anyone not marked and makes you safe from far-away enemies.
Trade when Akali is low on energy; she cannot spam Five Point Strike then, and you can walk up to her.
Close the gap with Audacious Charge, then hit her with Three Talon Strike; the third attack knocks her up.
Stay out of a straight line with Anivia so Flash Frost misses; its stun is the main danger to you.
Her ice wall blocks movement, so don't chase her through Crystallize; wait for it to melt or go around it.
Kill Anivia fast when she dies, since her egg returns her at full health; stay on the egg with your attacks.
Use Wind Becomes Lightning to hit her from range; it slows her and marks her, so Audacious Charge reaches farther.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap on Aurora, then finish the third Three Talon Strike attack to knock her up.
Aurora turns invisible after Across the Veil, but Wind Becomes Lightning reveals any champion its thrust hits. Aim it at where she landed.
Step out of the line of The Weirding, or she will slow you. Then charge in while it is on cooldown.
Do not walk through the edge of her Between Worlds rift if you can avoid it. Enemies who touch the border are slowed.
Use Crescent Guard when she bursts you. Enemies outside the sweep cannot damage you for a while.
Close the gap with Audacious Charge, then fight right away. Cassiopeia is weakest when you are on top of her.
Land the third Three Talon Strike so she is knocked up and can't walk away or turn around for a moment.
Save Crescent Guard for when you are on her. It knocks her back and stuns her if she is not Challenged, and the damage is high.
Step out of Miasma's clouds quickly. They slow you, and you can't use Audacious Charge while stuck in them.
Walk sideways while her Noxious Blast lands; it has a short delay, so it is easy to dodge.
Face her when she casts Petrifying Gaze and you get stunned. Charge in from behind or the side so she can't easily stun you.
Walk up and use Audacious Charge when Fizz steps forward to trade, then finish with Three Talon Strike. His slow won't save him from your follow-up.
Land the third Three Talon Strike hit to knock Fizz up, but expect him to dodge by going untargetable with Playful, so bait it out first.
Audacious Charge can't hit Fizz while he is balanced on his trident. Wait until he lands, then jump on him.
Hit Fizz with the end of Wind Becomes Lightning so he is slowed and revealed. That stops him from slipping away easily.
Save Crescent Guard for after Fizz has used Playful. It makes you safe from enemies standing far away, and his burst is shorter without his dodge.
Stay away from minions when Fizz's Chum the Waters is ready. Spread out from your team, since the shark knocks back everything near its target.
Walk up and hit Malzahar only after his Void Shift is gone; while it is up he takes almost no damage and cannot be controlled.
Dodge Call of the Void by stepping out of the line between its two portals; getting silenced stops your whole combo.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap on Malzahar, then start Three Talon Strike right away so you can knock him up on the third hit.
Hit Malzahar with Wind Becomes Lightning to slow him and mark him as Challenged. Your Audacious Charge then reaches him from farther away.
Do not walk into Malzahar's Nether Grasp alone; save Crescent Guard for after he commits, and stay clear of his zone on the ground.
Stay away from minions carrying Malefic Visions; when they die it jumps to the nearest enemy, which can be you.
Charge in with Audacious Charge when she steps up to poke, then hit her with Three Talon Strike; the third hit knocks her up.
Aim Wind Becomes Lightning at her from a distance; the thrust slows her and keeps going past minions, so you can hit her behind them.
Once Wind Becomes Lightning has marked her as Challenged, Audacious Charge reaches farther, so use it to close the gap when she backs away.
Hold Crescent Guard for when she has dropped her Ball near you. Her Command: Shockwave is her best answer, so wait for her to spend it first.
Walk at her with Three Talon Strike ready to trade. She can't hurt you much when you stay on her, because her damage comes from the Ball's area.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap when Ryze steps up to trade, then finish the three Three Talon Strike attacks so the last one knocks him up.
Ryze has no dash, so Wind Becomes Lightning is hard for him to dodge once you are close. It also slows him, so you can stay on top of him.
Use Audacious Charge on a Challenged Ryze to reach him from farther away. Wind Becomes Lightning is how you mark him.
Hold Crescent Guard for when Ryze is Rooted and in range. It knocks back and stuns anyone not Challenged, so hit it before you have marked him.
Do not stand in the lane taking poke. Ryze's Spell Flux spreads and sets up his Rune Prison root, so trade only when you can reach him.
Crescent Guard makes you immune to enemies outside its range, so use it in a fight to avoid Ryze's damage from range.
Fight Sylas right after he spends Abduct or Chain Lash. Then charge in with Audacious Charge and finish with your Three Talon Strike attacks.
Stay out of a straight line with Sylas. Abduct stuns the first enemy it hits and pulls him onto you, so keep minions between you.
Hit Sylas with Wind Becomes Lightning as he walks up. It slows him and marks him as Challenged, which extends your charge range.
Do not run on a low-health Sylas without care. Kingslayer heals him a lot when he is low, so burst him down fast or back off.
Save Crescent Guard for when Sylas commits to you. Once you use it, he cannot hit you from outside its sweep.
Close the gap with Audacious Charge, then finish Three Talon Strike. The third hit knocks the enemy up.
Twisted Fate's Gold Card stuns. Attack him while his Pick a Card is on cooldown or still shuffling.
Stay out of a straight line from Twisted Fate when you can. Wild Cards is a fan of cards, and it hurts to get hit by all of it.
Hit Twisted Fate with Wind Becomes Lightning to slow him and mark him as Challenged. Then Audacious Charge reaches him from farther away.
Don't wander far from your lane when Destiny is ready. Twisted Fate can teleport in with Destiny and gank you from nowhere.
Charge in with Audacious Charge once Viktor has used his spells, then finish him with Three Talon Strike before he can walk away.
Do not stand still in Gravity Field. Walk out of it before it activates, or you will be stunned.
Sidestep Hextech Ray by walking out of its line, since it is a slow beam. Move away from the line again before the aftershock explodes.
Use Wind Becomes Lightning to hit Viktor from a distance. It slows him and lets your Audacious Charge reach him from farther away.
Keep Crescent Guard for when Viktor is close and Challenged by your attacks, or he will not be knocked back. It also protects you from his far-away spells.
Walk up and use Audacious Charge on Yasuo when he is out of position; he cannot dodge it, and it slows him.
Land the third Three Talon Strike to knock him up, then follow with your other abilities while he is held.
Don't cluster your allies on him when he has a knock up ready; knocked-up allies let Yasuo use Last Breath.
Aim Wind Becomes Lightning only after Wind Wall has been used or is off cooldown; it is a projectile and the wall can stop it.
Use Crescent Guard when he dives you; it knocks back enemies who are not Challenged, and you take no damage from enemies outside the sweep.
Hit Yone with Wind Becomes Lightning to slow him and mark him as Challenged, then use Audacious Charge, which reaches farther against marked enemies.
Land all three Three Talon Strike attacks for the knock up. It also lowers your other cooldowns, so it is your main way to win a trade.
Hold Crescent Guard until Yone commits. It knocks back and stuns him unless he is Challenged, and you take no damage from enemies outside the sweep.
Do not walk into Yone's Mortal Steel while he has two stacks. His third cast dashes and knocks you up, so step out of the line or trade before he gets there.
Hit Zed with the third Three Talon Strike to knock him up. It is a good way to stop him from engaging or escaping.
Use Audacious Charge to close the gap when Zed backs off after a trade. It reaches farther against a Challenged target.
Fire Wind Becomes Lightning at Zed when he walks up. The thrust slows him and reveals him, even if he tries to hide.
Once Zed uses Death Mark on you, use Crescent Guard. You take no damage from enemies outside its sweep range.
